_note: Template only — farmhand auto-installs via bundleInstallPlugin (AGENT_CORE_BUNDLE.corePlugins). Entry and integrity are injected at install time. The first non-agent effect-capable plugin: it imports host code-ops (LSP) and surfaces find-references + rename-symbol to the agent via capability-tools, proving a plugin can EXTEND the agent without the agent depending on it.
name: LSP Code Ops

find-references.doc: Find all references to a symbol at a source location (file, line, column) via the language server. Returns each reference's file/line/column/kind. Prefer this over text search for accurate symbol references.

rename-symbol.doc: Rename a symbol at a source location across the entire project via the language server (workspace rename). Returns files-changed and edit count. Prefer this over manual find-and-replace for correctness.

move-symbol.doc: Move a top-level item at a source location to another file via the language server (workspace edit). Returns files-changed and edit count. Move is server-dependent — a language server that does not implement it returns an error. Prefer this over cut-and-paste for correctness.
